Honble X Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate
Mayo Hall, Bengaluru (Annexure A) And Etc.,
 This Petition, Coming On For Admission, This Day,
The Court Made The Following:
 Order
The petitioner/accused Nos.1 and 2 herein along with other accused were charge sheeted for the offences punishable under Sections 420 and 120B read with Section 34 of IPC.
2. Learned Magistrate after accepting the charge sheet took cognizance of the aforesaid offences and issued summons.
The cognizance taken by the learned Magistrate was impugned by accused Nos.3 and 4 before this Court in Criminal Petition No.8571/2019 and connected petition.
This Court, by order dated 20.07.2022 quashed the impugned proceedings as against accused Nos.3 and 4.
The accused herein also stand on similar footing as that of accused Nos.3 and 4 and so as to maintaining parity, the impugned proceedings requires to be quashed as against the accused herein.

3. Accordingly, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER i. The Criminal Petition is allowed.

ii. The impugned proceedings in C.C.No.54525/2016 on the file of X Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate at Bengaluru, insofar as it relates to the petitioner/accused Nos.1 and 2 is hereby quashed.
